k2046:
A plot of land at Karpen, in the Kavajë area, directly adjoining the main road.

The total area is 1,500 m². The land has an ownership certificate and the mortgage documentation is in order.

Karpen lies on the coast road south of Durrës, between the Golem–Qerret resort strip and Kavajë, and the land along that road has been moving steadily from agriculture to development as the coast builds out. Road frontage is the attribute that decides what a plot here can become: access for construction, visibility for a commercial use, and a straightforward connection to utilities.

At roughly €23 per square metre this is an inexpensive holding. Before buying, confirm with the municipality what the plot is zoned for and what building permission would be realistic — agricultural land can be bought freely, but what it is worth depends entirely on what can be built on it.
k2047: 500 m² plot near Arapaj Lake, Durrës
k2048: A titled 500 m² plot in a quiet setting near Arapaj Lake, a short distance from the main road — sized for a single family house.
k2049:
A plot of land in the Arapaj Lake area of Durrës, in a quiet setting with good access and not far from the main road.

The total area is 500 m². There is an ownership certificate and the mortgage documentation is in order.

Arapaj sits in the hills just east of Durrës, above the coast, and has become the place where people from the city build their own houses: it is five to ten minutes from the centre and the beaches, but green, quieter and cheaper per square metre than anything on the flat ground by the sea. Five hundred square metres is the classic size for a detached family house with a garden.

Before committing, check two things with the municipality — the permitted building use and height for this parcel, and the position of water, sewage and power connections — and look at the access road in winter as well as summer, since some of the lanes around the lake are unmade.
k2050: Furnished 2+1 of 85 m² at Sheshi Pranvera, Durrës
k2051: A furnished two-bedroom flat with a separate kitchen, 79.44 m² net, on the fifth floor of a managed building. There is no lift.
k2052:
A 2+1 apartment in the Sheshi Pranvera area of Durrës, one of the quieter and more popular residential parts of the city.

The gross area is 85 m² and the net 79.44 m²: a living room, two bedrooms, a separate kitchen, a bathroom and a balcony, on the fifth floor. It is sold furnished, the building is managed, and the mortgage documentation is in order.

The separate kitchen is worth noting. Most newer flats in Durrës open the kitchen into the living room; a closed kitchen keeps cooking out of the sitting area and gives the living room back its full size — a layout many families still prefer.

The building has no lift, and the flat is on the fifth floor. That is the practical limit of this property and the reason for its price: fine for someone who does not mind stairs, much less so with small children, heavy shopping or older relatives. Decide on that first, and the rest of the flat — generous net area, quiet location, ready to move into — makes a good case for itself.
k2053: Front sea-view 2+1 of 104 m² on the tenth floor, Vollga, Durrës
k2054: A furnished two-bedroom flat with an unobstructed front view of the sea, a minute from the promenade, in a well-kept building managed year-round.
k2055:
A 2+1 apartment in Vollga, Durrës, with a front-on view of the sea, one minute from the promenade.

The area is 104 m²: a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, one bathroom and a balcony, on the tenth floor. The building has a lift, is very well maintained and is managed throughout the year. The flat is well furnished.

The tenth floor is what the price is for. In Vollga the promenade is lined with towers, and at lower levels the view is often of the building across the street; from the tenth floor facing the sea there is nothing between the balcony and the bay. Views like this in central Durrës do not come up often, and they are not something a later building can take away at this height.

A hundred and four square metres is generous for two bedrooms. The one limitation is a single bathroom for a flat of this size and price — ask whether the layout allows a second, since at this level of the market it is what buyers and tenants expect.
k2056: South-facing sea-view 2+1 of 117 m² with two bathrooms, Plazh Hekurudha
k2057: A furnished two-bedroom flat of 107 m² net with two bathrooms and two balconies, on the fifth floor of a new, year-round managed building.
k2058:
A 2+1 apartment at Plazh Hekurudha in Durrës, in a new building that is well managed throughout the year, with a view of the sea.

The gross area is 117 m² and the net 107 m²: a living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and two balconies, on the fifth residential floor. It faces south, is sold furnished as shown in the photographs, the cubic measurement is registered and the mortgage documentation is in order.

This is a well-specified flat. Two bathrooms with two bedrooms means each bedroom effectively has its own — what makes a two-bedroom work for two couples, for guests, or for letting at a higher rate. South-facing means sun through the day and a warmer, drier flat in winter, which on the Durrës coast is worth more than it sounds.

The price is quoted per square metre, at €1,200. On the gross area that comes to roughly €140,000, but confirm with the seller which area the rate is applied to before comparing it with other listings.
k2059: Luxury 4+1 of 360 m² with gym and sauna, Plazh Iliria, Durrës
k2060: A fully finished 320 m² net apartment close to the sea: two living rooms, four bedrooms and four bathrooms, a dressing room, laundry, private gym and sauna, and a balcony along its full length.
k2061:
A luxury 4+1 apartment at Plazh Iliria in Durrës, very close to the sea, on the first residential floor (the second above the ground).

The gross area is 360 m² and the net 320 m². It has two living rooms with a kitchen, a separate dining room, four bedrooms, a dressing room, a laundry room, a private gym and a sauna, and four bathrooms. A balcony runs along the entire length of the apartment.

The flat has been fully fitted out with quality materials: parquet floors, wall-mounted air conditioning in every room and natural light throughout the day.

This is closer to a villa set on one floor than to an apartment, and it should be compared with villas rather than flats: at this size, a separate dining room, a gym and a sauna are rooms, not extras. The low floor is a deliberate trade — immediate access and no dependence on the lift, at the cost of the high-floor view — and suits a family that will actually live here rather than visit.

Property at this level in Durrës is a narrow market, and the price reflects the finish rather than the square metre. Ask for the service charge, and for what is included in the sale among the fittings and furniture.
k2062: 870 m² plot on the main road with ownership certificate, Plazh, Durrës
k2063: A titled 870 m² plot directly on the main road in the Plazh area of Durrës — developable land inside the city's beach district.
k2064:
A plot of land in the Plazh area of Durrës, directly on the main road.

The total area is 870 m². The land has an ownership certificate and the mortgage documentation is in order.

Free land inside Plazh is rare. The beach district is built up almost continuously from the railway to Golem, and most new projects there begin by demolishing something. A clear, titled plot with road frontage avoids that step entirely, and 870 m² is enough for a small residential block, a guesthouse or a commercial building, depending on what the local plan permits.

At around €120 per square metre, the price sits between agricultural land on the outskirts and serviced city plots. What the land is actually worth depends on the permitted building coefficient and height, so obtain the planning status from the municipality before negotiating.
k2065: Five-storey villa of 824 m² with business floors and apartments, near Kazazi, Durrës
k2066: A titled five-floor building combining a café-bar, car wash and hall on the lower floors with two homes and an attic above — business and residence under one roof.
k2067:
A five-storey villa in a well-regarded area near Kazazi in Durrës, with a regular ownership certificate and a total built area of 824.4 m².

The building is organised floor by floor:

Ground floor, 159.4 m²: a café-bar, a storeroom and a car wash — a working commercial level.
First floor, 175 m²: a large hall suited to events, a gym, a showroom or offices.
Second floor, 175 m²: a home with a living room and kitchen, two bedrooms and two bathrooms.
Third floor, 140 m² plus a 35 m² veranda: a living room, a separate kitchen and a bathroom.
Fourth floor, 140 m²: an attic.

This is best understood as a mixed-use building rather than a villa in the usual sense. An owner can live upstairs and run or let the lower floors, and the income from a café, a car wash and a hall is what makes the price make sense. The attic and the third floor are also clear candidates for conversion into further apartments.

Before buying, confirm that the commercial uses on the ground and first floors are covered by the building's permits and the certificate, and ask for the current turnover or rent of the operating businesses.
k2068: 100 m² ground-floor commercial unit, UKD area, Durrës
k2069: A visible street-level unit near the Durrës university, suited to a café, a shop, a beauty business or a showroom.
k2070:
A commercial unit in the UKD area of Durrës, around the Aleksandër Moisiu University, with a good position and high visibility.

The area is 100 m², on the ground floor, with one bathroom. The unit is easy to find from the street and has straightforward customer access.

The university shapes this part of the city: steady foot traffic through the academic year, a young clientele and demand for cafés, quick food, printing and study services, clothing and beauty. A hundred square metres is a comfortable size for most of those uses — large enough for seating in a café, small enough to run without staff costs getting out of hand.

The price is quoted at €1,300 per square metre, which puts the unit at roughly €130,000. It is worth asking the seller what comparable units nearby rent for; in a student area the rental yield is usually the clearest test of the price.
k2071: 194 m² ground-floor commercial unit, UKD area, Durrës
k2072: A large, visible street-level unit near the Durrës university — room for a full café or restaurant, a larger shop or a showroom.
k2073:
A commercial unit in the UKD area of Durrës, near the Aleksandër Moisiu University, in a well-placed and highly visible position.

The area is 194 m², on the ground floor, with one bathroom, and the unit is easy to identify from the street with easy customer access.

This is the larger of two units offered in the same area. At nearly two hundred square metres it opens up formats the smaller one cannot hold: a restaurant with a proper kitchen, a café with a large seating area for students, a furniture or appliance showroom, or a unit divided into two smaller shops.

The price is quoted at €1,300 per square metre, around €252,000 for the whole unit. For a space this size one bathroom is a constraint for catering use, where regulations normally require separate staff and customer facilities — check what fit-out a food business here would need before settling on the price.
